emma: Quick ops — planning a paid push tied to the Apr 28 webinar. Goal: signups + warm retarget. High-level: search + retarget creative refresh, 7–10 day pacing test, then roll.

- Search: top 30 intent keywords (brand + product intent), start with tCPA strategy, target CPA $45, initial daily budget $1,200. Ramp: 20% first 48h -> 60% day 3 -> 100% day 7.
- Retarget: 14d window, two creative sets (A: webinar invite, B: case study/social proof), creative swap every 72h, kill bottom 30%.
- Geo split: US 70 / CA 10 / EU 20.
- Landing pages: LP-A (full register flow), LP-B (short form + calendar). UTM pattern: utm_source=paid&utm_campaign=webinar_apr28&utm_content=creative_{A|B}.

I'll create the draft in Ads and tag folks. Thoughts?

ryan_ads: +1 to tCPA. Suggestions: enable DSA for long-tail queries, set start bid multiplier +10% for brand exacts. For retarget CPM, initial bid $5.50 and cap creative frequency 3/day. Also add a geo bid adjustment instead of hard split so we can scale.

lina_growth: Landing page ask: can we A/B hero copy around "low latency" vs "cost savings"? Need GA4 event webinar_id + conversion fires. Also want to test shorter thank-you flow for higher TTF (time-to-first-email).

noah_pm: Messaging riffs (short):
- Variant A: "Ship LLM features with 5x lower inference latency."
- Variant B: "Cut inference cost without re-architecting your stack."
I'll finalize 3 headline variants and 2 descriptions by EOD.

sam_ops: Routing: send leads to HubSpot workflow "WB-Apr-28". If lead_score >= 50 auto-book demo via Calendly webhook /webhooks/ads-leads -> /integrations/hubspot/webhook. Ensure PII scrubbing and log to audit. Also need CRM field mapping for model_interest, infra_size.

ads-bot: Campaign draft created: https://ads.internal/redwood/campaigns/1792 (draft).

ryan_ads: Quick budget bump script (will run with vault token):
```bash
curl -X POST https://ads.api.company/update_budget -H "Authorization: Bearer $VAULT_TOKEN" -d '{"campaign_id":"1792","daily_budget":1200}'
```

emma: Action items: ryan_ads -> enable tCPA + DSA, upload creatives A/B, set frequency cap; lina_growth -> GA4 events + UTMs, LP A/B setup; noah_pm -> finalize copy by EOD; sam_ops -> webhook & HubSpot routing, CRM mapping. I'll run review 9am tomorrow. :thumbsup:

any blockers?
